classes.name: manifest
classes.reason: Every rank sits at `barrier.wait()` immediately before and after `_read_staged(manifest(...))`, so the whole job is held until that one round's manifest read finishes, and each round has its own file m%d read once per rank.

classes.name: sidecar
classes.reason: After the post-manifest barrier each rank synchronously `_read`s its own `sidecar(workdir, me, i, ...)` files while other ranks read theirs, and the same rank re-reads each of its sidecar files once in every one of the cell.rounds=200 iterations.

classes.name: shard
classes.reason: Each rank blocks on `_read(shard(workdir, me, i), SHARD_BYTES)` for its own private shards outside any barrier, repeating the read of each shard file in every one of the 200 rounds.
